note: One entry per hole, in the order played. par = 3/4/5, buggy and n8 = strokes. Optional: course and date (on the first hole of each round). Stats, each as {"buggy": x, "n8": x}: putts (number), fw ('hit' | 'l' | 'r', par 4/5 only), gir (true/false, only when it differs from score − putts ≤ par − 2), sand (bunker holes), lost (lost balls), pen (penalty strokes).
